mapper.insert: INSERT INTO palace_rooms (id, wing, room, hall, last_updated, source_book_count) VALUES (uuid_generate_v4(), #{wing}, #{room}, #{hall}, now(), 1) ON CONFLICT (wing, room) DO UPDATE SET source_book_count = palace_rooms.source_book_count + 1, last_updated = now()
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM palace_projection_version WHERE status = 'current'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO palace_projection_version (id, version_num, last_ingestion_batch_id, created_at, status, room_count) VALUES (uuid_generate_v4(), 1, #{jobId, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.zhangspaghetti.babytalk.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, now(), 'current', #{roomCount})
mapper.update: UPDATE palace_projection_version SET version_num = version_num + 1, last_ingestion_batch_id = #{jobId, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.zhangspaghetti.babytalk.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, room_count = #{roomCount} WHERE status = 'current'
mapper.select: SELECT id::text FROM palace_rooms WHERE wing = #{wing} AND room = #{room}
SELECT id, wing, room FROM palace_rooms WHERE wing != #{wing}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO palace_bridge_edges (id, room_a_id, room_b_id, confidence, status, source_book_a, source_book_b, created_at) VALUES (uuid_generate_v4(), #{roomAId, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.zhangspaghetti.babytalk.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{roomBId, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.zhangspaghetti.babytalk.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{confidence}, 'proposed', #{sourceBookA}, #{sourceBookB}, now()) ON CONFLICT (room_a_id, room_b_id) DO NOTHING
